title: My Daily Routine
description: Four short recordings about daily life: a morning chat, an afternoon talk, a phone message and a weekend chat.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · A morning chat
parts.intro: You will hear Nam and Mai talking about their mornings.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Hi, Mai. You look tired today. What time do you get up?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: I get up at six o'clock, but today I woke up at five. My dog was very noisy.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Oh dear! What do you do in the morning?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: First I have a shower. Then I eat breakfast. I usually have eggs and bread. My brother has rice, but I don't like it in the morning.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Do you walk to school?

script.speaker: Mai
script.text: No, I go by bus. It leaves at seven fifteen. Sometimes I'm late. I think about a taxi, but it's too expensive, so I run!

parts.title: Part 2 · Peter's afternoon
parts.intro: You will hear a boy, Peter, talking about his afternoon.

script.speaker: Peter
script.text: Hello, my name is Peter, and I'm twelve. I want to tell you about my afternoon and evening.

script.speaker: Peter
script.text: School finishes at half past three. I go home and have a snack, usually an apple and some milk.

script.speaker: Peter
script.text: At four o'clock I do my homework. It takes an hour. I like maths, but I don't like English homework.

script.speaker: Peter
script.text: After that I play football with my friends in the park. We play until six, when it gets dark.

script.speaker: Peter
script.text: We have dinner at seven. My dad cooks on Mondays and Fridays. I go to bed at half past nine.

parts.title: Part 3 · A message from Mum
parts.intro: You will hear a phone message from Minh's mum.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Hi, Minh. It's Mum. I'm still at work, and I finish late today, at half past six.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Please wash the rice and put it in the cooker at five o'clock. Don't forget!

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Your sister has a piano lesson at four. Please take her there, and bring her home by bus.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Oh, and the dog needs food. It's in the kitchen cupboard, not in the fridge.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Thanks, Minh. Call me if you have a problem. Bye!

parts.title: Part 4 · The weekend
parts.intro: You will hear Lan and Jack talking about Sundays.

script.speaker: Lan
script.text: Jack, what do you do on Sundays?

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: I sleep late! I get up at ten o'clock. Then I call my grandmother.

script.speaker: Lan
script.text: Do you visit her?

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Yes, in the afternoon. She lives near the river. We cook together, and we watch a film.

script.speaker: Lan
script.text: That sounds lovely. I'm busy on Sundays. I clean my room, and I wash my clothes.

script.speaker: Jack
script.text: Oh, I hate cleaning. I only clean my room once a month.

script.speaker: Lan
script.text: In the evening I read a book or listen to music. I love music.
